checks.explanation: COVID-19 deaths did rise as the Delta wave hit later in 2021, driven predominantly by unvaccinated people.
No vaccine-evading variant caused mass mortality among the vaccinated or forced a renewed economy-wide shutdown; Omicron proved more transmissible but markedly less lethal.
COVID-19 became and remains endemic, circulating with periodic outbreaks for years, confirming the prediction.
DeepMind's AlphaFold Protein Structure Database expanded to over 200 million protein structures across nearly all cataloged species, exceeding the predicted 100 million, freely searchable.
Many AI-driven drug discovery companies emerged in subsequent years, but a direct causal attribution of "hundreds" specifically to this database is difficult to verify.
Big tech platforms remain dominant as of 2026 with only modest decentralization pressure, though AI has introduced some new competitive dynamics; not a clean confirmation either way.
Private space efforts (SpaceX's Starship, reusability advances, Blue Origin's crewed flights) produced significant engineering breakthroughs in the years following.
